noun_definition: private_blocked_from_chat nvp refers to a non-visual property that determines whether a user who has been blocked from chat should have their UI for composing messages replaced with a blocking component.
ui refers to the user interface component that should be displayed to users who are blocked from chatting, replacing the compose box with a different element.
comments refers to the user-generated messages that can be sent in the chat interface, which should be blocked for users who have been flagged and restricted from chatting.
